title: Workspace Conductor: crosswalk railmap & lateral workspace switching prototype
creator: Priya Nair
description: Design an alternative navigation pattern ("Workspace Conductor") that decouples global workspace switching from context rail state and introduces a lateral ‘crosswalk’ for fast hops between workspaces, plus a compact railmap overlay for quick route preview. Outcome should improve discoverability of rollouts and per-workspace cost lenses while preserving quick access to compute region and model routing controls.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates workspace-to-workspace switch in <= 500ms perceptual flow
Crosswalk supports pinning two workspaces for one-click toggle
Railmap overlay surfaces per-route cost delta (relative %) and recent latency SLOs
Interactions documented with motion specs and accessibility keyboard flow
Handoff tokens (components, spacing, colors) exported for implementation and engineering review accepted
comments: 2025-01-23 - Priya Nair: Initial draft sketches uploaded. Two patterns explored: (A) persistent mini-rail crosswalk; (B) transient floating crosswalk. Chose transient for lower chrome on small viewports.

2025-01-28 - Ava Chen: Mid-fidelity screens posted. Added cost-lens microcard on hover showing 3 metrics: token-cost delta, cost-per-minute, estimated monthly spend (projected). Need PM to validate metric definitions.

2025-01-30 - Miguel Ortega (PM): Reviewed mid-fi. Metrics ok but rename 'cost-per-minute' to 'cost-rate' and include toggle to see absolute vs delta numbers. Also: backend can provide cost deltas for top-3 routes only — design should degrade gracefully.

2025-02-01 - Liam O'Neill (Eng): Engineering review: transient overlay ok; watch for overlay stacking with existing command palette. Suggest z-index + focus trap approach. Also flagged potential perf for railmap live SLOs — propose precomputed snapshot endpoint.

2025-02-03 - UX Research (Zoe Kim): Ran 6 guerrilla tests. Observations: users expect workspace switching to feel like 'teleport' (instant). Crosswalk pin/toggle is understood by 5/6 participants. Confusion on where rollout controls live — they expected rollouts under workspace menu; we should surface a 'rollouts' quick action in the conductor.

2025-02-05 - Ava Chen: Implemented rollouts quick action and a compact cost-lens view for railmap. Updated animations to use 120ms ease-in for entry and 80ms ease-out for exit per motion specs. Ready for design review session on 2025-02-06.

2025-02-06 - Priya Nair: Design review notes: minor copy changes, accessibility keyboard tab order fixed, added aria-live region for crosswalk open/close. Request engineering spike to validate snapshot endpoint and keyboard focus trap. Marking In Review.
decision_log: 2025-01-25: Choose transient floating crosswalk over persistent mini-rail to minimize permanent chrome and maintain deep-navigation density in the rail.
2025-01-30: Surface rollouts quick action in conductor header after UX research indicated discoverability issues.
2025-02-02: Show cost-lens as delta by default with toggle to absolute; backend will provide top-3 route deltas to keep payload small.
